steps.instruction: Dice 24 ounces of raw chicken breast.
Cook the chicken in a pan with oil until no pink is left.
Cook 16 ounces of macaroni in boiling water for 7 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cook the macaroni for a few minutes less than usual, about 7 to eight minutes.

steps.instruction: Add the chicken and the pasta to a casserole dish.
Mix the chicken and pasta together.
Mix in 16 ounces of diced tomatoes and 9 ounces of shredded mozzarella cheese.
Top with 1 1/2 ounces of parmesan cheese and 1 1/2 ounces of bread crumbs.
steps.spoken: Top with the parmesan cheese and bread crumbs, for an even coat. Add more mozzarella and parmesan if you like a lot of cheese.

steps.instruction: Dot the top evenly with 1 tablespoon of butter.
Bake for 22 minutes, until the top looks golden.
steps.spoken: Bake for 22 to twenty-five minutes, until the top looks golden.
